title: 第21章 两枚真灵蛋第22章 专业背锅天剑宗
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
云星落隐身站在人群当中，悄悄开启异瞳，她注意到巨蛋并不是不继续孵化，而是灵气不够了。
“它灵气不够了。”
云星落突然间开口，“破壳需要太多灵气，这个聚灵阵虽然巨大，然而经过上万年的运转，功能大不如前。”
“再加上破壳需要的灵气更多，如果按照目前的速度，至少还得十天半月甚至更久才能破壳。”
“十天半月，我们可不能等这么久。”
有人开始焦急起来。
黑雾森林千变万化，今天妖兽出没不多，明天可能就遍地是妖兽。
“那怎么办呢，段道友，你不是懂很多嘛，出个主意。”
这一次，段则然是真的不知道了。
他讪讪地站在原地，好几次张开嘴都不知道说什么。
“之前叫你装逼。”
肖鹤在山洞外不屑地哼了一声。
段则然顿时怒了，“肖鹤，你们敢鄙视我，我诅咒你等下被人坑。”
肖鹤又哼了一声，“我肖鹤皎皎君子，从不得罪人，怎能被人坑。
倒是你段则然，什么时候改一改这喜欢吹牛逼的毛病。”
山洞中，云星落差点没被肖鹤的话搞吐。
皎皎君子，馋师妹身子的皎皎君子，舔狗一个。
不过眼下她不想和这个虚伪的舔狗争辩，怎么让圣兽破壳，抢到圣兽才是正道。
她意识进入太初圣图之中，问道，“图图，这个蛋灵气不够了，怎么办？”
图图正在睡懒觉，懒洋洋爬起来，瞥了外界一眼。

“灵气不够就补充灵气啊，这么多修士，身上那么多灵石，使劲砸啊！”
“有道理。”
云星落把自己知道的说了，“诸位，想要快点让圣兽破壳，就不要吝啬自己的口袋，我们给圣蛋捐灵石吧，给它增加点灵气。”
说罢，她象征性地扔出一块灵石。
反正她穷，比不过那些大宗门弟子。
众人看到云星落只扔出一块灵石，有人就笑了，“真是抠门，只出一块灵石，圣兽都看不起你。”
“就是，我感觉这是圣兽的考验，说不定谁出的灵石多，到时候圣兽就跟谁走呢。”
“哈哈哈，那一定是老子。”
段则然很自信地扔出一万块中品灵石。
肖鹤很鄙视地在外面叫嚣，“一万块中品灵石就很多了？我出三万块上品灵石，让我进山洞。”
“想砸钱进来？没门，老子不缺钱。”
话落，段则然取出十万块上品灵石，扔进了聚灵阵。
content_en:
Yun Xingluo stood invisible among the crowd and quietly opened her special pupils. She noticed that it was not that the dome would not continue to hatch, but that it had insufficient spiritual energy.
"It's not spiritual enough."
Yun Xingluo suddenly spoke, "Breaking the shell requires too much spiritual energy. Although this spirit gathering array is huge, after tens of thousands of years of operation, its function is not as good as before."
"In addition, breaking the shell requires more spiritual energy. If we go at the current speed, it will take at least ten and a half months or even longer to break the shell."
"Ten days and a half, we can't wait so long."
Some people started to get anxious.
The Black Mist Forest is ever-changing. Today there are not many monsters, but tomorrow it may be full of monsters.
"Then what should we do, Fellow Daoist Duan, don't you know a lot? Come up with an idea."
This time, Duan Zeran really didn't know.
He stood there awkwardly, opening his mouth several times without knowing what to say.
"I told you to show off before."
Xiao He snorted disdainfully outside the cave.
Duan Zeran suddenly became angry, "Xiao He, you dare to despise me, I curse you to be cheated later."
Xiao He snorted again, "I, Xiao He, a gentleman, never offend anyone, how could I be cheated by others.
But Duan Zeran, when will you change your habit of bragging? "
In the cave, Yun Xingluo almost vomited at Xiao He's words.
A bright gentleman, a bright gentleman who is greedy for Junior Sister's body, licks a dog.
But right now, she didn't want to argue with this hypocritical licking dog. How to let the holy beast break out of its shell and grab the holy beast was the right way.
Her consciousness entered the Holy Picture of Taichu and asked, "Tutu, this egg's spiritual energy is not enough, what should I do?"
Tutu was sleeping in, lazily got up and glanced at the outside world.
"If your spiritual energy is not enough, replenish it. There are so many monks with so many spiritual stones on them, so smash them as hard as you can!"
"That makes sense."
Yun Xingluo said what he knew, "Everyone, if you want the holy beast to break out of its shell quickly, don't be stingy with your pockets. Let's donate spiritual stones to the holy egg to add some spiritual energy to it."
After that, she threw a spiritual stone symbolically.
Anyway, she is poor and cannot compare with those big sect disciples.
When everyone saw that Yun Xingluo only threw out one spiritual stone, some people laughed, "You are really stingy. Even the holy beasts will look down on you if you only throw out one spiritual stone."
"That's right, I feel like this is a test of the Holy Beast. Whoever produces more spiritual stones may be followed by the Holy Beast."
"Hahaha, that must be me."
Duan Zeran confidently threw out 10,000 middle-grade spiritual stones.
Xiao He shouted outside with contempt, "Is ten thousand middle-grade spiritual stones a lot? I'll give you thirty thousand high-grade spiritual stones to let me enter the cave."
"Want to spend money to get in? No way, I'm not short of money."
After saying this, Duan Zeran took out one hundred thousand high-grade spiritual stones and threw them into the spirit gathering array.
